what_this_is: The SBGR surround re-query: minor streets and building footprints the phase-1 extract deliberately cut, fetched 2026-08-26 for the surround round (the owner's verdict on the aerial tour: 'o entorno esta todo muito vazio'). Streets are the urbanization mask - Brazilian OSM maps streets/buildings far more completely than landuse. See surround_osm.py for the exact query and the wider bbox rationale.
